# ValveResourceFormat binary dependency

Download the Source2Viewer CLI 20.1 release from:

https://github.com/ValveResourceFormat/ValveResourceFormat/releases/tag/20.1

Extract `Source2Viewer-CLI.exe`, its native DLLs, and `LICENSE.txt` into this
directory. Binary files in this directory are intentionally ignored by Git.

The files used for the validated 1.2.x releases had these SHA-256 values:

```text
ef9f6fb3943c30b73f0991bce6654128727b0807968f7997a6bb014efbec8830  Source2Viewer-CLI.exe
0d98e29c028b3315d0e0344d02cd7aa4080abdf17fa67086847da13435320f2a  libSkiaSharp.dll
6426b3f1a11f6a324569794cd44ab97905009a77bd3be12a4e7fe42cede774c2  spirv-cross.dll
```
